## Download

Click **OilApp.zip** under *Assets* below. If your browser warns about the download, choose **Keep**.

## First-time setup (Windows)

1. Open your Downloads folder, **right-click OilApp.zip** and choose **Extract All...**, then click **Extract**. A folder called **OilApp** opens with **oilApp.exe** inside.
   Don't run oilApp.exe straight from the zip without extracting it first, or nothing you do will be saved.
2. Drag the **OilApp** folder onto your Desktop.
3. Open it and double-click **oilApp.exe**. If Windows says *"Windows protected your PC"*, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
4. A black window opens, then the app opens in your browser. Keep the black window open while you use the app, and close it to quit.

Your wallet and trades are saved in **oil_data.sqlite**, which appears next to oilApp.exe the first time it runs. Keep the two files together.

**Updating from an older version:** close the app, extract the new zip, and replace the old oilApp.exe with the new one. Leave oil_data.sqlite where it is and your progress carries over.

Having trouble? See the [instructions and troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/{{REPO}}/blob/{{TAG}}/README.md#troubleshooting).
